title: Kamal Quadir, BRAC Bank and the Slow Road to bKash in 2011
conflicts: Formation year 2010 (Daily Star, TBS, Future Startup) vs 'founded 2011' (Rest of World); story uses 2010 for the joint venture and 21 July 2011 for launch. The 37 staff are attached to 2010 founding by the Daily Star and to the 2011 launch by TBS; story attaches them to the launch. Sequence of the Kenya trips relative to the 26 August 2008 presentation differs between Quadir's two interviews; story avoids a strict order. Nick Hughes 'founded M-Pesa' (Daily Star 2017) softened to 'one of the people behind M-Pesa'.
notes: A nice Kenya link: Quadir studied M-Pesa on several trips to Kenya in 2008-09. The 2011 bank-led-only MFS rule rests on a single Business Standard report and is stated plainly but not cross-checked. The Banker and the Harvard Mittal PDF were blocked and not used. Quote is Analects II.22 (stance affirms).
